show.description: The Eternal Champion follows the rise of Mehul Singhania, a man of unshakable resolve who battles betrayal, power struggles, and hidden agendas. Torn between his ex-wife Natasha, his loyal confidante Aaisha, and his destined fiancée Padmini, Mehul faces off against ruthless business tycoons like Cyrus Daruwala, Rushaad, and the influential Mittals. In a world where loyalty shifts like shadows, Mehul stands unbroken the one man destined to change the game forever.
